research_note: WebSearch budget ran out partway through; the rest was checked with direct WebFetch calls on primary or reputable URLs. Fields marked 'unverified' were not re-checked in this session.

patoshi.blocks: ~22,000 blocks, each a 50 BTC coinbase. Lerner says 99.9% are unspent.
patoshi.coinbase_outputs_addresses: ~22,000 separate coinbase outputs and addresses, one per block. Arkham added '22,000 addresses' to its Satoshi Nakamoto entity on 2025-02-05.
patoshi.block_range: Starts at block 1, right after genesis (Lerner). Whale Alert puts the last Patoshi block at 54,316 (mempool.space timestamp 2010-05-03 13:17 UTC). Hashrate drops off after ~block 18k (Lerner 2020).
patoshi.script_type: P2PK: <65-byte uncompressed pubkey> OP_CHECKSIG. scriptPubKey is 0x41 + pubkey + 0xac (67 bytes). There is no address field. Esplora/mempool report scriptpubkey_type='p2pk' with no scriptpubkey_address (checked on the block 9 coinbase). Project Eleven estimates ~1.7M BTC sits in 2009-2011 P2PK coinbase outputs, not all of it Patoshi.
patoshi.spent_by_patoshi: About 800 BTC across 16 payments, each using at most 16 coinbase rewards (Cointelegraph Magazine, citing Lerner).
patoshi.attribution_caveat: Attribution is probabilistic and based on ExtraNonce/nonce patterns. Other research estimates ~750k BTC. Many non-Patoshi miners were active in 2009-2010, so 'Satoshi-era' is not the same as 'Satoshi'. Example: block 3654 moved on 2020-05-20 and is not Patoshi.
patoshi.misconception_wallets: Satoshi's coins are not in one wallet, and not in '~25 wallets'. They are ~22,000 independent 50-BTC P2PK UTXOs, each locked to its own public key. Any single Patoshi spend is a 50 BTC event. A real 'Satoshi moves' event would show up as one or more of these specific coinbase outputs being spent. I found no primary source for the '25 wallets' figure; it looks like folklore.

genesis_note.fact: The 50 BTC genesis coinbase can never be spent because of a quirk in how the genesis block is coded. Other coins sent to the address are believed to be spendable.
genesis_note.receiving_is_not_moving: The address receives tribute or dust deposits all the time. mempool.space chain_stats as of 2026-10-11: funded_txo_count=80,363, funded_txo_sum=57.58 BTC, spent_txo_count=0, plus 2 more incoming in the mempool. Example: someone sent 2.5 BTC (~$181k) to it in Feb 2026 (Arkham, 2026-02-10). Rule: alert only on inputs (vin) that spend Satoshi/Patoshi outputs, never on outputs (vout) that pay to them. Arkham/Whale Alert 'Satoshi wallet received X' headlines are noise.

endpoints.GET /block-height/:height: Plain-text block hash (verified for heights 9, 54316 and 100000).
endpoints.GET /block/:hash: JSON: id, height, version, timestamp, mediantime, bits, nonce, merkle_root, tx_count, size, weight, previousblockhash (mempool also returns difficulty). Cacheable forever.
endpoints.GET /block/:hash/raw: Binary serialized block, one call per block. Best for scanning every input locally.
endpoints.GET /block/:hash/txs/:start_index: 25 txs per page; start_index must be a multiple of 25. Includes vin[].prevout. A ~4k-tx block needs ~160 calls.
endpoints.GET /tx/:txid: JSON: txid, version, locktime, size, weight, fee, vin[], vout[], status. vin[] has txid, vout, is_coinbase, scriptsig, scriptsig_asm, inner_redeemscript_asm, inner_witnessscript_asm, sequence, witness[] (omitted when empty), and prevout. YES: prevout includes value (sats), scriptpubkey, scriptpubkey_asm and scriptpubkey_type. P2PK prevouts have no scriptpubkey_address.
endpoints.GET /tx/:txid/status: JSON {confirmed, block_height, block_hash, block_time}. Docs list only the first three, but block_time is returned. Verified: tx f4184fc5... gives block_height 170, block_time 1231731025.
endpoints.GET /address/:address: chain_stats/mempool_stats: funded_txo_count, funded_txo_sum, spent_txo_count, spent_txo_sum, tx_count. A spent_txo_count increase is a cheap 'did it move?' check for a watchlist.

esplora_api.scriptpubkey_type_values_seen: p2pk, p2pkh, p2sh, v0_p2wpkh, v0_p2wsh, v1_p2tr, op_return. Only 'p2pk' was checked live; the rest come from the electrs codebase and were not verified this session.
esplora_api.p2pk_spend_signature: A P2PK spend has a scriptSig with exactly ONE push: OP_PUSHBYTES_71/72/73 (0x47-0x49) + DER signature + sighash byte. No pubkey push and no witness. Verified on the Satoshi-to-Hal tx f4184fc596403b9d638783cf57adfe4c75c605f6356fbc91338530e9831e9e16, vin[0]: scriptsig_asm 'OP_PUSHBYTES_71 3044...01'; prevout type p2pk, value 5000000000, script 0x41 04 11db...ac. For contrast, P2PKH has two pushes (sig + 33/65-byte pubkey) and SegWit has an empty scriptSig with a witness.
esplora_api.detection_recipe: 1) Poll /blocks/tip/height every 60s. 2) On a new height, fetch /block-height/:h, then /block/:hash/raw. 3) Parse locally and pre-filter inputs whose scriptSig is a single 71-73-byte push with no witness (P2PK candidates). 4) For each candidate, GET /tx/:prev_txid/status and flag block_height <= 54316 (Patoshi window) or <= 100000 (2010, 'Satoshi-era'). Optionally GET /tx/:txid to read the prevout value. 5) Cross-check against a static Patoshi coinbase list (Lerner's dataset, built once offline). This costs about 150 block calls per day plus a few candidate lookups.

rate_limits_policy.mempool: No numeric limits are published. The docs say exceeding limits returns HTTP 429 and repeated violations may get you banned. They point to enterprise sponsorship for higher limits; self-hosting is possible (open source). Recommendations: <=1 req/s, exponential backoff on 429, cache block data forever.
rate_limits_policy.blockstream: Esplora API.md has no rate-limit statement. Blockstream's newer Explorer API tiers and auth could not be verified (fetch failed). Use it as a fallback with the same backoff.
rate_limits_policy.sandbox_note: From this Claude sandbox, Bash curl to both hosts was blocked by the egress proxy (403); WebFetch worked. Render production egress should not be affected, but test it.

thresholds.dormancy_definitions: Glassnode's standard age bands are 1y-2y, 2y-3y, 3y-5y, 5y-7y, 7y-10y and >10y (Supply Last Active, Spent Output Age Bands, Spent Volume). Its long-term-holder cutoff is ~155 days. In 2025-2026 coverage, Galaxy Research, Whale Alert and Arkham call '10y+' or '2009-2011 coins' 'Satoshi-era'/'ancient' and flag moves even of tens of BTC (26.96 BTC at 12.5y; 100 BTC at 16y). Common usage: 5y+ = long-dormant, 7y+ = very old, 10y+ = ancient/Satoshi-era.
thresholds.metric: Coin Days Destroyed (BTC x days dormant) and Coin Years Destroyed are Glassnode metrics. A simple score is btc_amount x coin_age_years ('BTC-years'). Reference points: 80,000 BTC x 14.25y = 1.14M BTC-years (2025-07-04); 600 BTC x 16.5y = 9,900 (2026-09-05); 50 BTC x 11.3y = 565 (2020-05-20).

suggested_rules_heuristic.condition: Any spend of a Patoshi coinbase output (P2PK, block <= 54316, in the Patoshi list or the Arkham Satoshi entity). Minimum event size is 50 BTC.
suggested_rules_heuristic.action: RISK_OFF immediately: block new longs and tighten stops. This has never happened; the 2020-05-20 'Satoshi' scare caused a fast ~2-3% wick on a non-Patoshi block.
RISK_OFF for 24-72h, or until it is resolved as custody/format migration vs exchange deposit (2025-07-04, then the Galaxy sale and the dip below $115k).

suggested_rules_heuristic.condition: >=1,000 BTC with age >=7y, OR government/trustee entity (USG, UK, Mt. Gox, China) moving >=1,000 BTC, especially to exchange-labeled addresses
suggested_rules_heuristic.action: DEFENSIVE posture: cut size by 50% and require higher confluence. Escalate to RISK_OFF if the destination is an exchange.

suggested_rules_heuristic.condition: >=100 BTC with age >=10y, OR P2PK coinbase spend with block <= 100000 that is not Patoshi
suggested_rules_heuristic.action: CAUTION flag in the Gemini context only. Historically little lasting impact (2024-09-20, 2026-09-05, 2026-10-07).

suggested_rules_heuristic.condition: Incoming transfers to the genesis or Satoshi addresses; moves <100 BTC at <10y

thresholds.caveats: Tier numbers are a heuristic built from the cases above, not a published standard; backtest before relying on them. A move is not a sale: many 2025-2026 awakenings went to custody or new SegWit/P2WPKH addresses (quantum or format upgrades; Decrypt 2026-08-29). Weight the destination more than the move (exchange-labeled vs fresh address). Respect the CLAUDE.md hard limits: this signal can only make the bot more defensive, never more aggressive.
